couplets.en: O wanderer, the world is a wayside inn.

lines: Sada raha hai kaun yahan pe, ik jaaye ik aaye
couplets.en: Who has ever stayed here forever, when one leaves as another arrives?

lines: Chhod ke apnon ka ye mela
couplets.en: We leave behind this gathering of loved ones.
O wanderer, the soul goes on alone.
The world is a wayside inn.

lines: Jitna daana paani, utna hi ho paaye
couplets.en: We live only as long as our allotted share of grain and water lasts.

lines: Boond na simte saagar mein kabhi
couplets.en: The drop is never contained by the sea.
The sea fits within the drop.
O wanderer, the world is a wayside inn.

lines: Sukh ke ujiyaare ke peechhe dukh ke kaale saaye
couplets.en: Behind the light of joy lie the dark shadows of sorrow.

lines: Jaan ke bhi anjaan bane sab
couplets.en: Everyone knows, yet everyone pretends otherwise.

lines: Kaun kise samjhaaye, kaun kise samjhaaye
couplets.en: Who is there to make another understand?
O wanderer, the world is a wayside inn.
